notes: User-pinned October 29 Home reference authorizes emerald grounds, mint actions, rounded care/activity cards, pastel shortcuts and raster wellness artwork. Earlier flat-only and no-raster guidance is superseded.
Light primitives come from theme/tokens.ts; dark variants come from AppearanceProvider. New installs default dark and saved preferences are preserved.
App content is bounded to 440 logical units with 16-unit page margins; setup/access retain 24. Navigation becomes a 96-unit side rail at 768.
Shortcuts adapt to two columns below 360 logical units or with enlarged text. Activity type/flow adapts without inventing readings.
Setup has three required profile steps, followed by one account-scoped optional access flow. Platform dialogs remain separate and permission denial preserves journal access.

Health refreshes every 30 seconds while active and on resume; wellness refreshes every 60 seconds. Optional Android background scheduling has a 15-minute minimum and can be delayed. Foreground phone steps are not all-day tracking.
Shared header keeps menu left, brand centered and bell right; back/title controls are a separate second row. Sidebar blur is an overlay, not decorative glass.
Home artwork PNGs have embedded exact prompts and adjacent JSON provenance. Banner and weather failure states do not substitute sample health or temperature values.
Super-admin UI is backend browser-only at /admin. Server-stored records differ from device-only connected readings; administrator actions are role-guarded and audited.
HTML snippets and synthetic Web captures support composition review only. Native permissions, blur, health-source timing and physical-device behavior remain unverified.

narrative.northStar: Growing Well - the supplied emerald Home reference
narrative.overview: The user-pinned Home screenshot replaces the earlier warm flat-only direction with emerald grounds, mint actions, rounded tonal task cards, pastel shortcuts and wellness imagery. Original Arogio branding is retained.
keyCharacteristics: Emerald dark canvas and mint-white light counterpart.
Rounded task surfaces, crisp Inter typography and readable spacing.
Pastel care shortcuts and real raster banner/water artwork.
Real recorded data, explicit sources and missing-data states.

rules.name: The Data Rule
rules.body: Values, progress and weekly bars come from saved goals and readings; missing data remains missing.

dos: Do preserve original Arogio branding and the pinned reference.
Do centralize optional access and keep tracking usable after denial.
Do keep administration in the backend browser portal.
donts: Don't invent weather, health values or completion.
Don't repeat permission prompts throughout trackers.
Don't call synthetic Web previews native verification.
